title: The Psychology of Fear in Politics
grammar: Analyzing fear-driven politics, authoritarian traps, and democratic maturity (politikai hisztéria, valóságérzék, bűnbakképzés)
goal: I can analyze Bibó István's diagnosis of collective fear and political hysteria in Central Europe
I can evaluate psychological defense mechanisms in political discourse (bűnbakképzés, önbecsapás)
I can discuss how existential anxiety undermines rational political judgment and reality sense
